picks.title: The Relic: First Guardian director confirms AI use after YouTubers sound the alarm over a preview build
picks.headline: The Relic: First Guardian director confirms AI use after YouTubers sound the alarm over a preview build
picks.excerpt: After creators flagged suspected AI content in a preview build of Soulslike The Relic: First Guardian, the director says AI touched only the early concept stage -- a few loading-screen concept pieces and consumable icons -- with none in the final game. A window into how studios are actually folding generative AI into the concept/design pipeline and the disclosure norms that now shape it.
picks.rationale: A concrete look at where a studio actually draws the line on generative AI (concept-stage only) and the disclosure norms now shaping game production pipelines. Credible outlet, distinct URL not in games history.

picks.title: Nexus Mods finally tightens the screws on AI — though it's still playing softball with the tide of slop
picks.headline: Nexus Mods finally tightens the screws on AI — though it's still playing softball with the tide of slop
picks.excerpt: The largest PC game modding platform is toughening its policy on generative AI, now requiring modders to properly disclose AI-generated assets in their uploads — a workflow/craft shift for the modding community as the platform grapples with AI 'slop'.
picks.rationale: A direct workflow rule change on the biggest PC modding platform: AI-generated assets now require disclosure, materially altering how modders publish and label their work. Distinct outlet-topic from the Kotaku pick; second same-category card gets a distinct accent from palette.
